Implement CoAP source module using Eclipse Californium library for efficient resource usage in constrained environments.

Develop REST client for Diego receptor APIs following standard HTTP and JSON practices.
Complete deployment properties using Spring Boot configuration mechanisms for flexibility and standardization.

HDFS cluster is secured with Kerberos or similar security protocol, and authorization is handled via user roles.
CoAP protocol implementation details are provided or standard libraries like Californium are sufficient.

All user stories are independent and can be developed in parallel or sequentially without significant dependencies.
